evals.name: install-from-natural-language
evals.prompt: 以后我每个 agent 的回复结尾都想看到一行小结：这轮干了什么、下一步做什么。帮我配上。
evals.expected_output: Runs `node scripts/recap.mjs install` (dry-run acceptable first) from the skill directory, then reports the per-agent coverage table from status, notes which agents are convention-fallback only, and tells the user to restart the agents. No hand-editing of config files.

evals.name: change-format-in-place
evals.prompt: recap 的前缀我不喜欢 🏁 了，换成 🎯，而且句子允许到三句
evals.expected_output: Edits CONFIG (prefix, maxSentences) at the top of scripts/recap.mjs, re-runs install, and confirms the update happened in place — exactly one managed region per file, no duplicates, no uninstall/reinstall.

evals.name: remove-everywhere
evals.prompt: 把 recap 这东西从我的 agent 里全撤掉，不想要了
evals.expected_output: Runs `node scripts/recap.mjs remove` (dry-run acceptable), then confirms marked regions were stripped, the OpenCode plugin file was deleted, files the skill created wholesale were deleted, and pre-existing user content was left untouched.
